t: 第一期的"柏林克"(Berlingske)是丹麦最古老的"持续经营"报纸.
te: The first issue of Berlingske, Denmark's oldest continually operating newspaper, is published.
dz: 第一期的"柏林克"(Berlingske)是丹麦最古老的"持续经营"报纸.
de: The first issue of Berlingske, Denmark's oldest continually operating newspaper, is published.

t: 本宁·温特沃斯发行了"新罕布什尔州第一笔赠款",导致佛蒙特州的成立.
te: Benning Wentworth issues the first of the New Hampshire Grants, leading to the establishment of Vermont.
dz: 本宁·温特沃斯发行了"新罕布什尔州第一笔赠款",导致佛蒙特州的成立.
de: Benning Wentworth issues the first of the New Hampshire Grants, leading to the establishment of Vermont.

t: 维罗纳的"茶特罗"(Teatro Filarmonico)被大火所摧毁,因为表演后在贵族的盒子…
te: The Teatro Filarmonico in Verona is destroyed by fire, as a result of a torch being left behind in the box of a noblema…
dz: 维罗纳的"茶特罗"(Teatro Filarmonico)被大火所摧毁,因为表演后在贵族的盒子中留下了一把火炬. 1754年重建.
de: The Teatro Filarmonico in Verona is destroyed by fire, as a result of a torch being left behind in the box of a nobleman after a performance. It is rebuilt in 1754.

t: 大不列颠国王乔治二世授予俄亥俄公司以俄亥俄河分叉周围的土地特许地.
te: King George II of Great Britain grants the Ohio Company a charter of land around the forks of the Ohio River.
dz: 大不列颠国王乔治二世授予俄亥俄公司以俄亥俄河分叉周围的土地特许地.
de: King George II of Great Britain grants the Ohio Company a charter of land around the forks of the Ohio River.

t: 新斯科舍省哈利法克斯成立.
dz: 新斯科舍省哈利法克斯成立.
